page.overview:
Who is Banker?

The runs the Clock Town Bank in West Clock Town or South Clock Town in . He recognizes his clients by stamping them with invisible ink. Therefore, he recognizes Link in all his forms. The keeps track of Link's balance even after he plays the "Song of Time" to return to the First Day. This is the only way Link can keep all the Rupees he has collected after traveling back in time.

The awards Link with gifts based on how much the latter deposits. These are the Adult Wallet at 200 Rupees, a 5 Rupees interest at 1,000, and finally a Piece of Heart at 5,000. The will stop taking deposits if Link reaches 5,000 Rupees in his account. The charges 4 Rupees for withdrawing at night; during the day, it is free.

The remains at his post until the end of the Final Day, applauding Link for staying behind as well. If the hero requests a withdrawal on the Final Day, the tells him not to believe the rumors about the falling Moon before proceeding.

The is outspoken and often makes impertinent comments during transactions. If Link attempts to overdraw his account, he will get mad at him. When Link exceeds the deposit limit, the makes a discriminatory, albeit positive, remark about his age. He calls Link "little guy" rather than by name, even when speaking to Zora or Goron Link.
